subject: info-algn
title: INFO.ALGN.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 36 (SD(SY)-14). INFO-ALGN (information alignment) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: AFN (affinity negation) and ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From ALT-F: AFI-2 (affinity insight—second degree) and PROG-EXT-FT (progressional extended functionalism). From AFI-2: ALT-ACT (alternative activism), ATT (attitude) and APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion". From PROG-EXT-FT: PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) and ALT-D (alternative definitions).
